description: Defines the rx::ShaderD3D class which implements shader functionality for Direct3D in the ANGLE project, including methods for compilation, uniform management, and feature usage queries.

classes.name: ShaderD3D
classes.description: Implements Direct3D-specific shader functionality, including compilation, uniform management, and feature usage detection.

methods.name: ShaderD3D
methods.description: Constructor initializing ShaderD3D with shader state, features, and extensions.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the shader with given context and options.

methods.name: getDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns debug information for the shader.

methods.name: hasUniform
methods.description: Checks if a uniform with the given name exists.

methods.name: getUniformRegister
methods.description: Retrieves the register index of a uniform by name.

methods.name: getUniformBlockRegister
methods.description: Retrieves the register index of a uniform block.

methods.name: getShaderStorageBlockRegister
methods.description: Retrieves the register index of a shader storage block.

methods.name: useImage2DFunction
methods.description: Checks if a specific image2D function is used.

methods.name: getCompilerOutputType
methods.description: Returns the output type of the shader compiler.
